Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund
Sponsor: Scofield
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 04/06/2021
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 383 as introduced would implement the provisions of the constitutional amendment proposed by Senate Bill 362 or House Bill 565 of the 2021 Regular Session, which, if ratified, would allow the Alabama State Parks Enhancement Authority, created by this constitutional amendment, to issue up to $80 million in general obligation bonds to be used for acquisition, construction, equipping, improvement, maintenance, provision, and renovation of Alabama state parks system under the jurisdiction of the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources (DCNR). This bill would provide for the debt service payments from the State General Fund for these bonds. If ratified, the corresponding constitutional amendment would increase the State General Fund debt service by an estimated $5.5 million annually over a 20-year period beginning with fiscal year 2023.
This bill also provides for the administration of the issuance and refunding of these bonds; creates the Alabama State Parks Enhancement Fund to receive the bond proceeds and investment income; requires property acquired by the authority to be conveyed to DCNR; and provides for the dissolution of the authority.
This bill also allows the authority to acquire real or personal property, employ professional staff, enter into contracts, and transfer funds to DCNR to carry out the business of the authority.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund

FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 383 as introduced would implement the provisions of the constitutional amendment proposed by Senate Bill 362 or House Bill 565 of the 2021 Regular Session, which, if ratified, would allow the Alabama State Parks Enhancement Authority, created by this constitutional amendment, to issue up to $80 million in general obligation bonds to be used for acquisition, construction, equipping, improvement, maintenance, provision, and renovation of Alabama state parks system under the jurisdiction of the Department of Conservation and Natural Resources (DCNR). This bill would provide for the debt service payments from the State General Fund for these bonds. If ratified, the corresponding constitutional amendment would increase the State General Fund debt service by an estimated $5.5 million annually over a 20-year period beginning with fiscal year 2023.
This bill also provides for the administration of the issuance and refunding of these bonds; creates the Alabama State Parks Enhancement Fund to receive the bond proceeds and investment income; requires property acquired by the authority to be conveyed to DCNR; and provides for the dissolution of the authority.
This bill also allows the authority to acquire real or personal property, employ professional staff, enter into contracts, and transfer funds to DCNR to carry out the business of the authority.
As amended and reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation General Fund provides that any bond proceeds in excess of $80,000,000, plus expenses, related to the original issue premium in connection with the sale of bonds shall be allocated to the Alabama Forestry Commission, for capital improvements, renovation, equipping, acquisition, provision, construction, and maintenance of state forests.
Greg Albritton, Chairperson
Finance and Taxation General Fund
